## What Happened [[2024-09-24|Yesterday]]?

- **Recount**:: I have not been happy with my off days lately. I feel like I just cannot get into the swing of things and that I just end up wasting my days. Yesterday, I procrastinated with OneNote so much that I only went through one unit section in the calculus prep course. The amount that I am procrastinating is making me doubt that I am making any progress. I need to find a way to get past the frustration I feel after having to update my task manager from not doing so in previous days, specifically work days.
- **Recount**:: Yesterday evening, Sam told me about how she feels she is often blamed for almost everything. Considering her childhood, it makes complete sense. I was happy she finally told me that she feels I blame her for things and that it can lead to her being angry with me. It is important for her and our relationship that she shares these feelings, but it is still very hard that I feel I have to just be quiet the whole time and just accept everything she is saying without any interaction. It ends up feeling like she is putting her feelings on me and that I just have to take it.
- **Recount**:: This morning really upset me. I already felt off because I had to start my morning with course registration and then to make matters worse, I did laundry and later down the line my laptop froze and it took almost thirty minutes until it was usable again.
